privacy.ai_training_note: Epidemic Sound trains AI tools (Studio, Adapt) exclusively on its own licensed music catalog. Does NOT train on customer-uploaded content. Does NOT sell or license customer data to other AI companies. Does NOT accept AI-generated music from creators. All artists can opt out of AI features and receive direct compensation for AI usage (expanded artist bonus pool from $3.7M to $4.2M in 2026, plus $1M dedicated AI fund).
privacy.data_region: EU/EEA (based in Stockholm, Sweden); data may be transferred outside EU/EEA via Standard Contractual Clauses

flags: A third-party profile (Nudge Security) claims SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, FedRAMP, CSA STAR Level 1, and PCI DSS certifications for Epidemic Sound. A site search of epidemicsound.com for these terms yields no results, and no dedicated security or trust center page exists on Epidemic Sound's public website, so these claims are not confirmed.

Unlike many enterprise software vendors, Epidemic Sound does not publish a dedicated trust center or security documentation page; security and compliance information is minimal and scattered across privacy policy fragments.
Complete data handling, retention, and processing details remain opaque.
Epidemic Sound's AI posture is transparently disclosed and customer-friendly: no training on customer data, an artist opt-out, and artist compensation, with no concerns identified.
